scope: Competition feasibility review, no deployment or GPU use

confirmed_facts.fact: DeepInfer current documented model/hardware targets are DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash and NVIDIA SM100/Huawei Ascend950
Its batch-invariant test passes generated trajectories as golden_token_ids to single-request replay and compares token/logprob/top-token outputs
Its CUDA graph runner keeps source/device metadata buffers and copies values for replay
Existing local MetaX adaptation forces top-k/top-p to PyTorch fallback because of Triton compilation errors; both-none returns input directly

competition_priorities.task: Fixed-prefix A/A and A/B numerical comparison; borrow diagnostic design, not unsupported DeepInfer flags
competition_priorities.not_proven: Our same-batch serial divergence has same root cause as DeepInfer batch-composition invariance

competition_priorities.task: Attribute official-workload sampler/fallback calls and full cost; inspect DeepSelect algorithm only if branch hits
competition_priorities.not_proven: sweep/histogram belongs to sampler, or top-k can replace full top-p semantics
